in_marathi.name: Gomathika
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gomathika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Go' meaning cow and 'Mathi' meaning wise, this name is bestowed upon a girl symbolizing her wisdom and calmness like a cow.

in_bengali.name: Gomathika
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Wise Cow
in_bengali.long_meaning: Gomathika একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Go' meaning cow and 'Mathi' meaning wise, this name is bestowed upon a girl symbolizing her wisdom and calmness like a cow.
